steps.title: Stock leaderboard — Proximity to 52-week high column
steps.narration: The Stocks leaderboard now shows each name's distance below its 52-week high in a dedicated column placed directly after Risk. A reading of -0.53% means the stock sits just below its annual peak; 0.00% means a fresh 52-week high.
steps.point_out: Look for the 'Proximity to 52w high' column header immediately to the right of the 'Risk' column — every row shows a live percentage.

steps.title: Sort by proximity ascending — furthest from the high first
steps.narration: Clicking the column header reorders all 120 stocks from those furthest below their 52-week high down to those sitting at or near their peak, making it easy to find names that have pulled back the most.
steps.point_out: A sort arrow appears on the 'Proximity to 52w high' header and the row order changes — MSTR moves to the top, reflecting its larger pullback from its annual high.

target.name: Sort by Proximity to 52w high, ascending

steps.title: Reverse the sort — leaders near their high float to the top
steps.narration: A second click flips the order so stocks trading at or nearest to their 52-week high appear first — the position where true market leaders tend to reside.
steps.point_out: The arrow flips direction and ARM moves to the front with a 0.00% reading, indicating it is sitting right at its 52-week high.

target.name: Sort by Proximity to 52w high, ascending

steps.title: Info icon surfaces the glossary definition
steps.narration: Every numeric column carries a small info icon that opens a plain-language definition pulled directly from the methodology catalog — the Proximity column is no exception.
steps.point_out: The popover explains that proximity-to-52w-high is a leadership component, not a buy signal on its own — the same config-backed copy that powers all other column tooltips in the table.

steps.title: Stock detail page shows the matching percentage
steps.narration: Opening MU's detail page confirms that the Leadership score component breakdown shows the exact same -0.53% figure that appeared in the leaderboard — one stored value, displayed consistently in both places.
steps.point_out: In the Leadership breakdown, the 'Proximity to 52w high' row reads -0.53%, identical to the leaderboard — no opaque internal rank like 'pctl 73', just the actual distance from the 52-week high.

steps.title: Dashboard loads with an honest readiness badge
steps.narration: The top-bar readiness badge now accurately reflects what the backend is doing — showing Ready when data is being served, an Initializing progress count during warm-up, or Backend unavailable only when the backend is genuinely down.
steps.point_out: The badge should read 'Ready' and the dashboard should display live market regime data — look for the 'Risk-on' label with its numerical score.

steps.title: Research lab continues to load after the connectivity fix
steps.narration: The same fix that corrected the readiness badge also ensures every other page — including the Factor Lab research view — continues to fetch and display data without error.
steps.point_out: The Research page should display 'Factor Lab' with its decile analysis tables and the badge should remain on 'Ready' throughout.
